text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The U.N. Security Council has set Wednesday -- the second anniversary of the signing of the Lusaka peace accord -- as deadline for the government and UNITA former rebels to complete military obligations in the plan which ended two decades of civil war.
- Angolan President Jose Eduardo dos Santos returned to Luanda on Tuesday night after a two-day official visit to Spain, which followed his trip to Rome to attend the World Food Summit.

- The Spanish government has offered to send a technical team to Angola to help to form the country's first unified elite police force, which will include UNITA officers, according to an announcement in Madrid.
